kaikki_vikisozluk.e: زَرْنَب or زَرْنُب • (zarnab or zarnub) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Unknown, the same as Classical Syriac ܙܪܢܒ (zarnVḇ), ܙܪܢܦ (zarnVp̄), ܙܪܢܘܒܬܐ (zarnūḇtā), ܙܪܢܘܦܬܐ (zarnūp̄tā), ܙܪܩܘܦܬܐ (zarqūp̄tā), seemingly containing ܙܪܥܐ (zarʿā, “seed”) often used in names of plants particularly if they provide spices.
g: mountain spignel (Libanotis pyrenaica) or sticky goosefoot (Dysphania botrys)
coffee plum, East Indian plum (Flacourtia cataphracta syn. Flacourtia jangomas)
